interpretation.addressing_histograms: Only memory instructions count as B1 accesses; register transfers are counted separately.
interpretation.estimates: Compact forms are assigned. Estimates count only residual long candidates under the current layout; forced widths and relocation can affect eligibility.
interpretation.instruction_counts: Retired user code for map 7 plus compiled K helper only, including compiler wrappers/guards; system retired and B include kernel/peer/IRQ work. IRQ entry is a B transition, not a retired instruction.
interpretation.references: Three hand-written programs match this fixed corpus I/O/result/data contract, with specialized loops and fewer general checks. Ratios measure this compiler baseline, not an unavoidable ISA cost.
interpretation.schedule: Each binary starts from its own artifact header; input is recorded when A is BLOCKED_READ and B has >=3 progress iterations at a U boundary. Events list exact per-binary B and sequence. Different binaries do not share numeric event B or fault PCs.
interpretation.stack: Maximum observed bytes below initial U SP=$2000 or helper K SP=$FFFE, including active call frames, arguments, spills and allocated locals. Guard aborts intentionally retain their faulting stack.

kernel.scope: Each assembled image counted once per group; excludes vectors, registry/data, duplicated user loads and compiler-specific boot/kernel variants.
